title: TWEDDIT: A Dataset of Triggering Stories Predominantly Shared by Women on Reddit
reasoning: The paper contains a core evaluation component focused on morals. Specifically, Section 6.3 (Moral Foundations in TWEDDIT) utilizes the Moral Foundation Theory (MFT) and the Domain Adaptation Moral Foundation (DAMF) model to analyze and score stories based on moral dimensions such as care, harm, authority, loyalty, purity, and degradation.
